content:
Jennifer Lawrence is opening up about all the cosmetic procedures she’d do ― if she wasn’t in the public eye.

“I can’t really get very much done,” the “Don’t Look Up” star told Vogue in an interview published last week. “I need to have movement in my face — I get baby Botox, but I can’t do a lot.”

Lawrence joked that “if my skin is going to be a little saggier than I would like, at least it looks dewy and pretty.”

While she doesn’t feel she can go under the knife herself, the 36-year-old made it clear she endorses those who do.

“I’m really nervous about these fat transfers. I support other people doing them because I want to continue to watch and see what happens, but I don’t know about that,” she said.

“I mean, I would love to have a buccal fat removal. I can’t because everybody would know, but just know that I want that,” the actor added.

The “Die My Love” star told The New Yorker last year that she wouldn’t do fillers (because they show on camera), but isn’t ruling out an eventual facelift.

“Believe me, I’m gonna!” she said, adding that she’d also consider a breast augmentation now that she’s had two kids.

“Everything bounced back, pretty much, after the first one,” Lawrence said. “Second one, nothing bounced back.”

The “Hunger Games” star maintained that she would do the augmentation whether she was famous or not.

“Maybe I wouldn’t be hustling to the appointment in the same way,” she explained. “But I think yes.”
